summary_1line: Garuda seizes an elephant and tortoise, rescues the Valakhilya sages from a falling branch, and seeks a safe place to drop the massive limb.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda grips an elephant and a tortoise in his claws while clutching a massive banyan branch in his beak, tiny Valakhilya sages hanging upside down from it.
The colossal bird Garuda soars through the sky shaking mountains with his wings, carrying the elephant and tortoise across vast landscapes below.
Kasyapa stands in ascetic meditation on Mount Gandhamadana as the immense Garuda approaches from the sky bearing his burdens.
